== English Decipher comparison ==
The November 1998 Glossary changes six passengers to one driver and five passengers. The Dark card's Tatooine deployment discount, reactive move and disembarking when lost remain.

Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=119 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 119. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 15. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=15 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=14 Decipher Errata slips], PDF page 14.
